verdict.rationale: The skills-install axis applies, since Ultrametric's CLI writes skill files into projects. However, the evidence shows only a single 'ultrametric' SKILL.md being written to two harness targets (Codex and Claude Code). The docs' mention of 'selected skill files' reads as choosing targets, not choosing individual skills from a multi-skill collection, so it is an adjacent control rather than per-skill install. No collection of distinct skills, and no way to pick a subset of one, is documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install only the specific skills I want from a collection instead of taking the whole bundle
